meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR:读取状态、合并可行性、CI 检查、评论和未解决评审线程,发现真问题就改代码、跑测试并推送,然后重新检查,循环直到 PR 干净。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、评审和 CI,直到所有可处理的问题都被解决时接管。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #123,直到它可以合并
say.note: 它会持续检查并修复问题

say.text: 盯着这个 PR 的评论和 CI,有问题就修好并推送
say.note: 每次推送后会重新检查

say.text: 这个 PR 还有哪些未解决的评审线程?
say.note: 列出未解决的线程清单

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stays with a PR: it reads status, mergeability, CI checks, comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues with focused commits, runs tests, pushes, then rechecks — looping until the PR is clean.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a pull request's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge
say_en.note: It keeps checking and fixing issues

say_en.text: Watch this PR's comments and CI; fix and push as needed
Which review threads on this PR are still unresolved?
